about: Discord #27: a prop listed by a cell whose instance was already gone when the game saved was written without x_pos, and loading that save stopped with 'x_pos not set before reading'. The load now leaves that prop out. gnx_scn_strip_prop_place takes x_pos off the first prop in the slot-9 save file.

steps.name: gnx_scn_strip_prop_place
steps.why: the fixture has a prop to strip
without the fix the load stops here
